title: Bond strength at three curing temperatures
intro: An adhesive was cured at 150, 170 and 190 °C, six lap joints at each temperature, and the joints pulled apart (bond strength, MPa). The data are in the long layout: one row per joint, a column Temp with the temperature it was cured at in °C (the factor) and a column Strength with its strength (the response). Does the curing temperature change the mean strength?
